name: ai-commit-message-generator
description: Generate git commit messages from staged changes using any OpenAI-compatible API — works with Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, LM Studio, OpenAI, and more.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, LM Studio, OpenAI, …)
Claude Code CLI — uses your existing Claude login/subscription
Codex CLI — uses your existing ChatGPT/OpenAI login
gitCommitAI.provider.description: How commit messages are generated: an HTTP API endpoint or an installed agent CLI.

gitCommitAI.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH and common install locations).

gitCommitAI.codexPath.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH and common install locations).

enumDescriptions: Detect the project's convention from config files (pyproject.toml, commitlint, semantic-release, …) or recent git history
Always use Conventional Commits format (feat, fix, chore, …)
Never add a format instruction — plain commit messages
gitCommitAI.commitStyle.description: Commit message style. In 'auto' mode, projects using semantic-release/commitizen/commitlint get Conventional Commits messages with the project's allowed types.

gitCommitAI.apiUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. Ollama, vLLM, OpenAI). Do not include trailing slash.

gitCommitAI.model.description: Model name to use for generation (e.g. llama3, gpt-4o, mistral).

gitCommitAI.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in the generated commit message.

gitCommitAI.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower values produce more deterministic output.

gitCommitAI.systemPrompt.description: Prompt sent to the LLM. Use {diff} as a placeholder for the staged diff.
